title: festuca inermis subsp. villosa
intro: Festuca inermis subsp. villosa, commonly known as woolly fescue, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, respiratory infections, and skin conditions, due to its health benefits of anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of woolly fescue include antioxidant and immunomodulatory effects, which contribute to its ability to protect against oxidative stress and modulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of woolly fescue include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
